integrity.prior_literature: Cyclic prime, Kronecker-product extremal blocks, ternary fourth minors and all-prime third minors are antecedents, not asserted new.
integrity.proof_method: Complete exact fifth-cyclotomic minor and affine-orbit enumeration in standalone Python; no approximate thresholds or sampling.

limitations: Proved only for fourth-order submatrices of the character matrix of the additive group of the 25-point affine plane. Exact finite exhaustive certificate, not a classification for all primes or cyclic groups of order 25. Earlier unlocated equivalent table remains possible.
title: Complete rank incidence of fourth-order Fourier minors on \(\mathbb F_5^2\)
